text: Ordered a double mcspicy meal on the app at darling Square at 11.30pm and on the app it says it closed at 00.59am. And I went there to my surprised it was closed. Tried to get the manager attention and went she came out she rudely turned me away even though it was raining. She could have cooked the order. Anyway she asked me to go to darling quarter or george street. I went there unwilling to darling quarter under the rain and to my horror it was closed, again the app said it’s opened. So I made a detour to george street branch and was really hungry. By that time the app did not have my option for double mcspicy and had to order something I didn’t want but it was too late and I was hungry. I ordered and waited a long time, the restaurant was busy and messy. Finally I checked with the unenthusiastic and unfriendly staff on my order and apparently they forgot it, and managed to prepare it straight away after a long wait. When I got home to my horror my upsized large fries was half (as per my pic) and burger looks pathetic with no letteuce. Refer to pictures below: wasted my time for horrible food worth less than half its value.
author: Lionel Lye

text:
I recently had a really disappointing experience at McASS and I feel like I need to speak up about it I lost my bag at the location and approached a staff member named Brandon who I was told is the manager .I asked him politely if he could check the CCTV to help me find it To my surprise he immediately responded No we don’t have any CCTV in a very dismissive and rude tone
I later found out that there is actually CCTV on site which made me feel like he either didn’t want to help or simply couldn’t be bothered When I asked again for help just trying to explain how important the bag was he became visibly irritated and acted like I was being a problem
As someone who was just trying to get help in a stressful situation this kind of attitude from a manager is unacceptable I understand that not every situation can be solved but the least I expected was kindness and a bit of effort
Is this really how you train your managers to deal with people who come to you for help? I hope this issue is taken seriously and I truly hope no one else has to be treated this way when they’re already upset and just looking for some support
author: Erhee Bulgaa

text:
I bought happy meal to collecting GRINCH toys.

It is okay if the toys are run out, but you should let customers know about it.
Not just gives us an unpopular and outdated toy, trying to fool us!
Especially the clerks laughed at how rubbish the toy is when they prepared the happy meal in front of me. 😳

When I asked for the toy I SHOULD GET, the clerk ignored me at first, then the manager came out.
The manager tried to mock me at first, said that Grinch toy had never come with happy meal. (Noway, I have gotten its for two weeks from more than ten McDonald’s stores in Australia.)
I spent time to find the official website news, then the manager changed her words. 🥵🤭

These vile staff treating and fooling people without any reason.
I have travelled more than 50 countries, eat  Mcdonald’s every where; This is the first time I have such awful experience. 👍🏻
author: Emma

text: An absolute sham of a business. Childlike serve/portions. Half-filled cups of beverages when no ice is requested and sundaes advertised are deceptive and misleading when they too are only half filled compared to the full serve in the advertisement. A total SCABBY organisation and scam to ensure very little is served by way of product. When questioning staff about portion sizes; being told they have serving portions to adhere too. Seriously, change your adverts to reflect the actual portion sizes served as they are misleading and deceptive advertising of your products. Better value is the corner store that knows how to really make burgers (with lettuce) and decent serve of fries and not infant burgers.
author: M

text: Terrible service and food. I am an avid McDonald’s customer, and when asked about having a bit of extra cheese for my filet o fish because there was a square the size of my thumb on my burger and it tasted terrible, the workers rudely laughed and told me that they only give half cheese slices for the fish burgers and refused to give me any more to make my $12 burger a little more edible. Worst McDonald’s food I’ve ever had, lukewarm, bad proportions, terrible, and evil service. Customer service isn’t so hard that you can’t be a decent person when working.
author: Explore Wanderlust

text: I ordered a barista made iced coffee. Someone who didn't know if it was a barista or an employee was unkind to see if he was already angry somewhere. I tried to go to the bathroom, but the door was locked and I couldn't go in. Someone else went to the counter and talked about something, and the door opened and locked so the next person couldn't come in either. The atmosphere is weird whether it was unkind or not. I don't want to come back. Please ask the manager to smile and educate the staff on kindness.
author: Jim hwang

text: Staff were incredibly incompetent. I ordered a frozen no sugar coke and was left waiting for ages. My app later said the order was collected. It was only after I asked them why it was taking so long that they told me the machine wasn’t working. They then said they couldn’t compensate me with a normal no sugar coke because of price difference (which they should have done for the inconvenience). The refund was also a hassle. Staff seemed liked they didn’t know what was happening half the time either.
author: Marco Matos Salinas

text: I came to order online from this place due to the disgusting behaviour from a different McDonalds employee at another place. When i proceeded to order i have only said “a small frozen coke” and i wasn’t finished ordering. But this employee cut me off and responded in a very disrespectful tone of voice saying “a small frozen coke? Come and order it then, bye-“. I was quite appalled and surprised at this behaviour. What is going on with the McDonald’s service???
author: Xanthea Evangelista

text:
My husband & I wanted a meal here but unfortunately the service was very poor. We were the only customers that weren’t served! One gentleman was waiting for his order. There was at least three staff just standing there talking about an order. We had waited at least 5 to 10 min before I said “ excuse me, we are waiting to be served! This whole time we were there the staff had not acknowledged us to say at least “ we will be with you in a minute.
Poor service!!
author: Lou Grigious

text: The floors were disgustingly dirty with the maintenance mopping by pushing food & rubbish around with a mop ,& water that smelt if sewerage. After ordering our food we waited quite a while , then received it but we're told to them wait to get the coffees , the poor young girl on then took multiple other orders by before then walking over to have to make the coffee - at least ,20-25 mins .
author: Gwenda Burton

text: Far and away the worst McDonald’s I’ve visited. Found food strewn across the tables including an open can of tuna, and the smell of urine permeated the place. Regrettably paid $7 for a thickshake that was the wrong flavour that took them 10 minutes to provide a replacement for in spite of there being barely any other customers.
author: Connor Lamb

text: Very disgusting it wasn’t warm. It was very cold. My happy meal. My thick shake was very soggy and watery. I also didn’t get a happy meal box. I ordered a water and I got a sparkling water. I am allergic. I ordered a happy meal and I didn’t get a toy. I had to ask for it and my food was cold disgraced.
author: Nia-Rose Sirone

text: I can see most negative feedbacks on Google were about the TOILET issue for this McDonald . I am running a takeaway business too so I know staff play tricks. Lock the toilet door or jam the door so that no customers can use it. Staff won’t need to clean it up. Your staff team has attitude issues.
author: Info TradeMe

text:
Okay. For the second time, they messed up my order. I ordered the Double Cheeseburger meal, but guess what? I only got the Cheeseburger meal. It completely ruined my morning.
It's honestly frustrating because it's the least busy hours, so how can they still manage to mess it up?
author: Tracy Mu

text: I asked for spicy crispy chiken clubhouse and this is what i got. Grilled and all the ingredients on the box not in burger, lettuce was more that whole burger ingredients and lettuce was worst. No tomato. Worst I've ever had in any maccas. Totally disappointed
author: Dipendra Dhakal

text: service was good and efficient but the food is terrible... absolutely no love put into the food whatsoever every time I've been here the burgers look like this. The electronic menus can't even get the scale of the burgers correct. How big is that big Mac?
